title: EXP-033-R2 — Clean Replay: Select Form Native Keyboard Filter Refresh
objective: Independently replay EXP-033 against the existing live Web Client using one Select Form dialog and no tested Cancel/reopen cycle. Record the inherited dialog state, establish Filter By=Name with Case Sensitive unchecked and Starts With unchecked, clear the current Name-filter textbox through native Ctrl+A followed by Backspace, and enter `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` using exactly one printable native key operation per character. Require the settled rendered grid to visibly contain the exact known-positive Name row before proceeding. Then clear the textbox through the same native path and enter the exact literal `FX_SelectFormKeyboardProbe01`, including lowercase `b` in `Keyboard`, again one printable character per native key operation, and require the settled rendered grid to show zero visible case-insensitive Name matches. Keep all conclusions limited to the rendered UI state; do not infer database absence, uniqueness, serialization, or a server refresh/requery mechanism. Finish with at most one ordinary Cancel solely to dismiss Select Form and no subsequent reopen.

acceptance_checks.description: Before browser interaction, record the harness-provided fresh worker/session identity distinct from EXP-033 worker `ses_ee9768333ffeV8zFkrUtEv19U6`; this must preserve the existing browser/Web Client/Designer context rather than replace it. If freshness cannot be demonstrated, stop blocked without replay promotion. Preflight evidence proves the inherited Web Client is already usable without session-establishment action, records whether Select Form was initially open, records its inherited filter text/settings/rendered rows, accounts for at most one initial ordinary Open if needed, and shows the inherited Web Client/Designer Form state remained untouched.

Positive-control action evidence proves the current Name-filter textbox was cleared with native Ctrl+A then Backspace and exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` was entered through exactly 25 successful one-printable-character native key operations, with Filter By=Name and both checkboxes unchecked; no bulk input, paste, JavaScript, Enter, OK, or result-row interaction occurred.

Settled positive-control evidence visibly shows a rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`. If this cannot be established within the shared recovery budget, the replay stops blocked before entering the probe.

Only after AC-3 passes, probe action evidence proves the textbox was cleared with native Ctrl+A then Backspace and exact `FX_SelectFormKeyboardProbe01` was entered through exactly 28 successful one-printable-character native key operations, including lowercase `b` in `Keyboard`, with Filter By=Name and both checkboxes unchecked.

Settled probe evidence visibly shows zero case-insensitive Name matches for exact `FX_SelectFormKeyboardProbe01`; the finding is explicitly limited to this rendered UI state and makes no database-absence, uniqueness, serialization, or server-refresh claim. Matching rows or unresolved stale/ambiguous rendering causes a blocked outcome without retyping or lifecycle retry.

The complete action audit proves the replay used only the required native keyboard clears and one-printable-character key operations for both exact strings, with no prohibited bulk input, clipboard paste, JavaScript/internal-store access, Enter, OK, result-row opening, tested Cancel/reopen cycle, Form mutation, Save, Regenerate, unload, preference change, or session-establishment action.

The entire run separately accounts for planned preflight/current-reference/focus checks, settled-result and final-audit evidence captures, and extra ambiguity recovery. Extra ambiguity recovery is limited to one additional fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total across both strings and all tasks; record used/remaining allowance, do not relabel repeated stale reads as planned evidence, and do not reset the allowance on worker/session changes. Any ambiguity remaining afterward produces a blocked result.

Final audit captures the last settled probe state, performs at most one ordinary final Cancel solely to dismiss Select Form, confirms no subsequent reopen, confirms inherited Web Client/Designer Forms remain untouched, and proves this experiment's repository writes are confined to the EXP-033-R2 record plus `evidence/EXP-033-R2/`; record pre-existing unrelated changes separately without modifying them. If AC-1 through AC-8 pass under the independently established fresh worker identity, the EXP-033 native-keyboard Select Form filtering procedure may be classified `replay_verified` only for the tested environment and UI workflow.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261007-212336-By3J. Rationale: EXP-033 completed successfully but its native-keyboard Select Form filtering behavior is only observed/candidate_procedure, not replay_verified. The smallest next learning step is an independent clean replay of that exact UI procedure in a fresh worker context, preserving the same positive-control and probe semantics while avoiding the original run's corrected uppercase-B detour. A successful replay would establish that the supported native Ctrl+A/Backspace plus one-printable-character-per-key path reproducibly drives the rendered Select Form result in the tested environment. This follows the project's preferred observed-to-replay_verified progression and does not depend on any blocked experiment.
